canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Oris Esheth: 38-year-old woman, 166 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: angular diamond face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: architectural high knot. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a hand-painted hem mark; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.
